review_comment: The code logs transaction validation error details to console, exposing sensitive internal state. The invalidReason field contains specific information about why transactions failed validation. Remove the console.log statement and ensure no sensitive validation details are written to debug logs.

The code includes raw exception messages in error reporting which may expose internal implementation details. While not directly exploitable, this could aid an attacker in understanding system internals. Sanitize or filter exception messages before inclusion in logs to prevent potential information leakage.
